result: Kernel residual of dynamic start-up attributed: about half is a measurement effect (libniji's pages mapped by no other process: +63k to +187k); the real excess (+100k/+146k/+283k/+393k empty/true/ls/sed) is whole-file views, written pages and extra mapping calls; empty and true reach parity by estimate, ls and sed keep +0..100k / +60..180k

rulings.item: Start-up comparisons against the reference measure libniji's ld.so/libc.so.6 pages as mapped by no other process (first-map/last-unmap accounting the reference skips): +63k to +187k kernel instructions per process
rulings.recommendation: run benchmark and workload-gate start-up comparisons with a holder process keeping libniji's ld.so and libc.so.6 mapped (probes/krp.py --only shared); re-baseline the affected bounds

informational: Replay of the exact mapping calls: removing whole-file views saves 33k/59k/92k/119k (lower bound), trimmed over-size 2k/27k/26k/36k, per-object reservation 3k-10k
